# ContentRemovalReviews.com

> The official reviews site for ContentRemoval.com, a content removal and reputation protection firm founded in 2017 by Frankie Lee and operated by Content Removal LLC (Miami, Florida, serving clients worldwide). One page: named client reviews, video testimonials, verified case studies and answers to common questions about ContentRemoval.com content removal services.

## What ContentRemoval.com does

Removes damaging content at the source: defamatory articles and attack websites, leaked and intimate images, fake accounts and impersonation, counterfeit stores and cloned websites, unfair reviews, pirated content, and harmful Google search results. Verified, confidential and success based. Every engagement starts with a free, confidential 15 minute Exposure Scan.
